text:
marta: Hey team — running the EdgeKit + LlamaIndex quickstart and hitting auth failures on refresh when running dev server. 401 Invalid token. Anyone seen this?

jchen: which SDK + version?

marta: js-sdk@0.9.2, Next 13 (app router). I set REDWOOD_API_KEY locally. The quickstart README mentions REDWOOD_API_KEY but the sample uses client creds flow? bit confusing.

sam (DevEx): fyi that README was edited pre-0.9.4. For hosted quickstarts REDWOOD_API_KEY should work; for private/dedicated you need client credentials (client_id/client_secret). Also JS SDK before 0.9.4 didn't surface Retry-After handling for 429s, so people hit 429s + then 401s in some flows.

maria (Eng-ML): Another angle: the LlamaIndex example in the starter does per-document embedding calls inside the ingest loop — that generates many small requests. Use batchEmbeddings or dedupe calls.

marta: repro steps were tiny:
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/edgekit -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
response body: {"error":"invalid_token","message":"token expired"}

jchen: quick workaround: set REDWOOD_API_KEY to a long-lived token OR switch sample to server-side client creds. I pushed a tiny patch to the sample app that checks for env and falls back: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edgekit-starters/commit/2b7f8a

sam (DevEx): I also added a retry wrapper around fetch in the sample to normalize behavior across SDKs. gist: https://gist.github.com/sam/edgekit-retry-snippet

marta: after pulling that patch staging responds fine — no 401s anymore. thanks! :tada:

deploy-bot: Deployed branch fix/sample-auth-fallback to staging (build #874) :rocket:

maria (Eng-ML): can we update onboarding doc to call out: 1) which env var to use for hosted vs private, 2) batch embeddings example, 3) running eval harness locally with small prompt set? newbies stumble on all three.

sam (DevEx): agreed. I'll open a docs issue and attach a minimal eval-harness script that runs 10 prompts locally and checks regressions. Also will note SDK parity: python already had retry-after handling, JS will get it in 0.9.5.

jchen: filed follow-up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/342 — include sample env matrix and a small snippet showing batchEmbeddings usage.

marta: leaving a quick note in the starter README too so people running `pnpm create` see it immediately.

sam (DevEx): plan: cut js-sdk 0.9.5 tomorrow with retry parity + publish patched starters. Thanks for the quick repro & confirm everyone.

maria (Eng-ML): one more request — can the eval harness also surface token/cost estimates per prompt? would help teams tune batching.

sam (DevEx): good idea, adding that to the issue.

marta: confirmed fixed for me on staging, closing my local loop. cheers! :beers:
